name: Moonlight Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of the few standalone restaurants in Mechuka's tiny main market — Tibetan-Memba kitchen serving momos, thukpa, and proper hot yak butter tea (not the diluted hotel version). Mechuka is largely homestay-fed; standalone restaurants here are the exception.
insider_tip: Mechuka is at 1,829m and remote — phone signal patchy, opening hours owner-set. Eat early; most kitchens here close by 8pm. Carry cash, ATMs unreliable.
signature_address: Main Market, Mechuka, Shi-Yomi, Arunachal Pradesh 791001
